# Download ## Setup Guide https://www.shipofharkinian.com/setup-guide ## Changes This release is the cumulation of over 500 commits ### Randomizer * Shuffles: signs, butterflies, wonder items, beggar, icicles, red ice, rocks, silver rupees, treasure chest game, zelda's letter, scarecrow song, masks * Progressive Biggoron's Sword, Progressive Open Chests * Logical bunny hood * Option to not be able to buy shields/tunics in shop until a random one is foundspee * Wincon options have been redesigned, one can now configure triforce pieces to award different rewards, wincon to be tied to different gates, & ganon's boss soul can be gated aside from ganon's boss key. These gates now immediately grant the reward, rather than being placed on gated light arrow cutscene, allowing LACS to be a regular check * Starting Items menu now a grid of item icons, & has been expanded to include many more items ### Enhancements * Cutscene skips are expanded, with more accurate time of day handling around intro skip, master sword cutscene, & sun's song cutscene * All bosses now have Boss Death skips * More minigame settings * Instant text * Improved support for large SAF audio packs * Enemy Randomizer includes Flare Dancer, & options to mitigate enemies falling into pits etc ### Speedrun mode Modes have been added: Speedrun & Speedrun MQ. These allow you to select presets designed in collaboration with [speedrun.com mods](https://www.speedrun.com/The_Legend_of_Zelda_Ocarina_of_Time__Ship_of_Harkinian) & the [OoT speedrunning community](https://discord.com/invite/7FYGh3d) ## What's Changed

# Download ## Setup Guide https://www.shipofharkinian.com/setup-guide ## Changes The team has been hard at work continuing to clean up the code to use hooks & refactoring logic for future work. This quiet release only brings small features like Anchor to play online with friends. Even if you aren’t playing with friends, join the global room while you are playing solo and you’ll be able to see all other players in the global room without the inventory & world syncing features enabled in normal rooms! See the Network tab for more information Two new accessibility options: remove sandstorm in Haunted Wasteland, remove wobble effect in Jabu Jabu New enhancements: Arrow cycling, remote bombchu, decouple Z-targeting lock-on from switching targets Mods can now modify equipment models without having to include Link's hands ### Randomizer Changes Fairysanity improvements: can catch checks with bottle, gossip stone fairy checks are instantly collected Pots now have CMC.
